usage: Save as extract_fields.py after operator review. Run `python3 extract_fields.py < input.json`, supplying one object with `text` and `fields`, or import and call `extract_fields(data)`. Uses only the Python standard library. Labels match exactly before the first colon; values have surrounding whitespace stripped and retain subsequent colons. Absent fields, unrequested labels, and lines without a colon (including bare `id`) are ignored. Duplicate requested labels or schema violations return {"error":"invalid_input"}. Otherwise returns {"fields":{...}}, preserving Unicode values. These delimiter and whitespace conventions are assumptions because the training inputs contain no expected outputs.
